status: CONTRACT FROZEN. Not implemented in this amendment.

whyThisExists.correction: The Stage 1 isolation tests are STATIC manifest, path and import validation. They read committed planning artifacts and assert their shape. They are NOT runtime proof, and this contract stops them being described as such.
whyThisExists.actualIsolationIs: a mandatory discover-mode gate that must run inside the same runtime boundary intended for execute mode, before execute is authorized

theAcquisitionProcessReceivesNo.note: Every entry is false: none of these is present inside the acquisition runtime boundary.

mayContainOnly: package and runtime files required to execute
runtimeBundle.builtWithUnrestrictedRepositoryCopyNote: A blanket COPY of the repository is prohibited: it would place .git, artifacts/, fixtures and the eval manifest inside the boundary and silently defeat every isolation claim above.

bundleManifest.contents: every bundled path with its SHA-256
bundleManifest.verifiedIn: discover mode, before execute is authorized

mustDo: recursively list every accessible mounted file
assert known forbidden paths cannot be opened
assert the repository root is unavailable
assert the post-freeze ID map is unavailable
assert the eval manifest and fixture paths are unavailable
verify only the four authorized mounts exist
discoverModeGate.executeAuthorizedOnlyAfter: the discover-mode evidence is reviewed and execute is explicitly authorized
